name: El Barraco (Spain)
description: Square white flag with a broad sky blue border, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of El Barraco (a stone boar on blue within a bordure of saltires).
history: The arms and the flag were approved officially by decree of 10 September 1993 (Boletín Oficial de Castilla y León no. 243 of 21 December 1993); the flag is a square white flag with a sky blue bordure and the municipal arms over the centre.

features.role: El Barraco arms — stone boar on blue
